import sys, json, os, subprocess
def request(nkeys, cap, mode='exact'):
    motifs=[[1515+20*k, 1516+20*k] for k in range(nkeys)]
    disc=[]
    for motif in motifs:
        for _ in range(2):
            vals=[0]*24+motif+[0]*24
            disc.append({'class':0,'values':vals,'activation':[0]*24+[100,100]+[0]*24})
    validation=[{'class':0,'values':[m for motif in motifs for m in motif][:128]}]
    rel={'id':'m','classes':1,'width':2,'eps':[1,1000],'ratio':[1,nkeys],
         'threshold':[0,1],'mode':mode,'packet_limit':2,'idle_us':0,
         'discovery':disc,'train':[{'class':0,'values':[1515,1516]}],
         'validation':validation}
    return {'capacity':{'range':cap,'exact':cap},'releases':[rel],'blocks':[[['install','m']]]}
env = dict(os.environ, SYNECDOCHE_SITE='/workspace/site', LD_LIBRARY_PATH='/workspace/native', PYTHONPATH='/workspace/site')
for nkeys, cap, mode, expect in [(3,3,'exact','ok'), (3,2,'exact','oversize'), (4,4,'exact','ok'),
                                 (5,4,'exact','oversize'), (1,0,'exact','oversize'), (1,1,'exact','ok'),
                                 (3,3,'range','ok'), (3,2,'range','oversize'), (4,4,'range','ok')]:
    req=request(nkeys,cap,mode)
    data=json.dumps(req,separators=(',',':')).encode()
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/workspace/submission/run.py'],input=data,capture_output=True,env=env)
    out=json.loads(p.stdout)
    cat=out['catalog'][0]
    got=out['installs'][0]['status']
    print('keys=%d cap=%d %s entries=%d kept=%d -> %s (expect %s) %s' % (nkeys,cap,mode,cat['entries'],len(cat['priority']),got,expect,'OK' if got==expect else 'FAIL'))
PYEOF
